definitions.explanation: Describes something that branches out into many different areas or directions. Almost always used in the fixed expression 多岐にわたる (to span many areas). Literally means 'many branches' (of a path).

examples.japanese: ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多岐|たき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたった。
examples.english: The discussion covered a wide range of topics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多岐|たき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる。
examples.english: His activities span a wide range of fields.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多岐|たき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたっており、⟦{全容|ぜんよう}→全容：11659_zenyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{把握|はあく}→把握：05625_haaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: The damage is wide-ranging, and it will still take time to grasp the full picture.

notes:
{多岐|たき} literally means "many branches" (of a road or path). It is almost exclusively used in the fixed expression {多岐|たき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる.

KEY EXPRESSION:
{多岐|たき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる: to span many areas, to be wide-ranging
- {多岐|たき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧: fields spanning many areas
- {多岐|たき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: problems covering many areas

REGISTER:
Formal and written. Common in news articles, reports, academic writing, and business documents. In casual conversation, ⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧ or いろいろな would be preferred.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {多岐|たき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる: spanning many branches/areas (formal, fixed expression)
- ⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧: wide-ranging, broad (more general, less formal)
- ⟦{多方面|たほうめん}→多方面：19726_tahoumen⟧: many directions/fields (similar formality)
